caption: Click a source field's connector, then the target's — a mapping line appears. Here, Id maps straight to Id.
The fx icon next to a target field opens a choice: map it with a Formula, or set a static Value.
Choosing Value, then entering "Closed" — every record in the target collection gets that same Status.
